description: Réseau routier principal existant de la Région Île-de-France inscrit sur la CDGT du Sdrif approuvé par décret le 27 décembre 2013 is a dataset listed in Plateforme open data de la Région Île-de-France, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by L'Institut Paris Region. Une sélection d'axes structurants routiers de niveau métropolitain a été retenue. On y trouve donc des et des nationales. Des différences peuvent apparaître entre ces données et la carte officielle du SDRIF approuvé par décret le 27 décembre 2013. Coverage: Île-de-France. The portal files it under Déplacements - transports, Aménagement du territoire. Its keywords are Planification, Aménagement, SDRIF, Route. The portal shows 3,977 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2021-02-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-iledefrance-fr-portal.
